verdict.rationale: Convex documents an official CLI (`npx convex`). It watches the filesystem and pushes functions and schema to the dev deployment, runs queries, mutations and actions with JSON args and `--watch`, and streams logs. It also handles import/export of data and shows health insights, so an agent or user can drive the full dev loop from the terminal. missing for 10: no evidence of agent-specific CLI ergonomics (e.g. machine-readable/JSON output modes, non-interactive auth), no independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Watches the local filesystem. When you change a function or the schema, the new versions are pushed to your dev deployment and the generated types in convex/_generated are updated.
npx convex run <functionName> [args] — Run a public or internal Convex query, mutation, or action on your development deployment.
npx convex logs — Watch logs from your deployment; npx convex export — Export data from your deployment to a ZIP file
npx convex insights — Show health insights for your deployment
